REPRODUCER:
    our %h = (k => 1, a => 1, b => 2);
    sub v3 { local @h{qw(a b)} = (5,6,7) } my @r = v3(); my $s = v3(); print "@r|$s\n";   # perl 5 6|3      PCL 5 6 7|ARRAY(0x1)
    sub w { local($h{k}) = 5 } @r = w(); $s = w(); print "@r|$s\n";                # perl 5|1        PCL 5|5
(s543g scratch/s543g/probes/m3/p09_listvalue.pl, p06_value.pl.)  The slice branch of Parser2::_local_plan_elem assigns with `(let ((*wantarray* t)) (p-setf (p-hslice ...) TMP))`, whose value is the RHS vector in any context; the items branch's `p-list-=` (s543g gave #1339's paren element that one) is right.  Routing the slice branch through p-list-= costs it (#1339's measurement: 1.14 -> 1.27 s); the -init case needs the count only when the statement is a valued tail in scalar context.
subject: SILENT WRONG (low): the VALUE of a valued `local` element/slice list assignment -- `sub f { local @h{qw(a b)} = (5,6,7) }` returns (5,6,7) / ARRAY(0x1) (perl (5,6) / 3); `sub w { local($h{k}) = 5 }` in scalar context returns 5 (perl 1, the count)
triage_reason: a sub tail `local` slice / paren-element assignment returns the wrong value
